name: Project Engagement Details
description: Detailed engagement summary covering goals, deliverables, and stakeholder alignment.

sections.title: Engagement Overview
sections.instruction: Brief description of the project or engagement, its purpose and scope, as described across the meetings.

sections.title: Goals & Success Criteria
sections.instruction: What success looks like for this category. Include measurable outcomes if mentioned in the meetings.

sections.title: Key Stakeholders
sections.instruction: People, teams, or organizations involved and their roles as identified from the meetings.

sections.title: Deliverables
sections.instruction: Agreed outputs, milestones, or artifacts with owners and due dates as discussed.

sections.title: Risks & Mitigations
sections.instruction: Known risks, their impact, and planned mitigations raised across the meetings.

sections.title: Decisions Made
sections.instruction: Key decisions taken across the meetings for this category, with rationale and approximate date if available.
